prompts.system: You write realistic test data for LostLink, a lost-and-found service on the National University of Singapore (NUS) campus. Reply with a JSON array only, without any other text.
prompts.groups:
Write {n} groups of look-alike everyday objects that students and staff lose on a university campus, three objects per group. The three objects in a group are the same kind of object and look alike: the same colour, and often the same brand (for example three black umbrellas, or three white AirPods cases). They differ only in small details, such as a sticker, a scratch, a keychain or what is inside. Use a different kind of object for each group.

For each object write two reports. Describe only the object, never where or when it was lost or found.
- "lost": what the owner types when reporting it lost, from memory. Vary the length: about a third of the lost reports are very short, 2 to 4 words (like "black umbrella"); the rest are 6 to 15 words and mention one or two identifying details.
- "found": what a staff member types when the object is handed in, 3 to 12 words. Staff describe what they see, in their own words, and often use a generic name instead of the brand. About half the time they mention the same identifying detail as the owner (in different words); otherwise they mention a different detail or none. Never write "my".

Return a JSON array of {n} objects, each with the keys "kind" (a few words) and "objects" (an array of 3 objects with the keys "lost" and "found").

meta.places_and_times: In each group the two true pairs are lost on the same day at places at least 800 m apart (groups 1-4: location separates them), at places within 400 m of each other 5-10 days apart (groups 5-8: time separates them), or within 400 m of each other on the same day (groups 9-10: neither does). Items are found where they were lost, 1-12 h later, except six pairs: object 2 of groups 1 and 9 and object 1 of group 5 are found at another place; object 1 of groups 2 and 10 and object 2 of group 6 are found at the same place 2-7 days later. The third object of a group is lost (groups 1-5) or found (groups 6-10) at the group's first place within 3 days in groups 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9, and at a random place and day in the others. Lost times are 09:00-18:00 in Sep 2026. Seed 5224.
